XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Fault light comes on / injection, poor performance, sudden engine shutdown
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | Engine management | malfunction | faults | performance | P0101 | P0106 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: All vehicles

  • System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: Fault/injection warning light comes on, poor performance, engine suddenly cuts out

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0101, P0106

  • Cause: Software error

• Action: Check that the cause of the fault light coming on is not due to mechanical or electrical faults. If no faults are found, proceed with the software update of the injection control unit

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: To perform the software update, contact an authorised service centre.
